notes.title: New Game Level
notes.notes: A new Game level has been added, so now you can try a chaotic and fun head-swapping fight with your friends!

notes.title: P2 supports mouse
notes.notes:
Some players gave feedback that the keyboard they were using didn't have a keypad.
So I added support for mouse actions, you can check the corresponding actions in Rules.:)

*I'm sorry, the customize button feature is still a bit difficult for me, maybe I'll update it in the future.Thanks again for playing my game!
